text:
alex: Quick convoabout prompt-sets approval UX. Proposal: when users approve items from a regression diff, we show a small persistent "approved" pill in the scorecard header that links to the diff, and surface an undo toast. thoughts? maria: love the idea, helps people find the change. one concern: how do we surface regressions introduced by the approval? need SR-friendly messaging. kevin: implementation thought: update the list in-place and emit an analytics event approval.bulk with {count, actor}. show pill "12 approved" and make it a button that opens the diff panel. asha: a11y notes: (1) toast must use role="status" and aria-live="polite" so it doesn't steal focus, (2) pill should be focusable and have aria-describedby pointing to a hidden status node with score delta details, (3) keyboard users must be able to tab to the pill and activate it. sanjay: microcopy: pill label should be short. maybe "12 approved 3 view diff"? the is visual only, keep SR label "12 approved, view diff". jessica: prefer separation: pill text "12 approved" and a small link icon with tooltip "View changes". keeps visual density low. alex: good call. also UX question: if approval is long (hundreds selected), show a progressive toast "Approving 120 of 300..." and final toast "Approved 300 prompt sets. Undo". how do we handle SR announcements mid-progress?\asha: don't announce every intermediate update. only announce final state. intermediate visual counters are fine, but SR should get the final result: "Approved 300 prompt sets. Press Undo to revert." Also provide an offscreen descriptive node with scorecard summary: "Scorecard: 4 regressions introduced, 1 resolved." and link pill should reference that.\kevin: dev note: server will batch approvals by 50. I'll add an event scorecard.update once backend returns new metrics. UI will update diff counts after that event.\maria: focus flow: when user triggers bulk-approve from toolbar, keep focus in toolbar. After approval, toast appears but do NOT move focus. Tab should reach Undo then pill. If user hits Esc or Undo, focus returns to the bulk toolbar. add acceptance criteria.\alex: acceptance criteria draft: 1) toast announced via aria-live role=status, 2) toast does not trap focus or steal it, 3) Undo keyboard accessible, 4) scorecard pill focusable and links to regression diff, 5) analytics events for approval.bulk and scorecard.update, 6) progressive visual count for large batches, final SR announce only.\sanjay: UX tweak: show a subtle green check icon in the pill and make the pill persist until manual dismiss or navigation to another run. avoids accidental loss of context.\jessica: copy style: sentence case for toast -> "Approved 12 prompt sets" and CTA "Undo". tooltip copy: "View regression diff".\kevin: will implement, plus unit + e2e tests and NVDA/VoiceOver smoke tests for the SR flows. adding code snippet to aria node: ```html
Scorecard updated: 4 regressions introduced, 1 resolved.
```\asha: include SR test steps in the PR: select items, trigger approve, assert SR reads final message, Tab to Undo, press Enter to revert and assert SR announces revert. include Esc path. deploy-bot: UAT deployed at feature/scorecard-pill-undo for testing. maria: thanks all. assigning implementation to @kevin, SR tests to @asha, UX follow-up to @jessica. will review after UAT verification.
